question: Only Indian citizens above the age of ________ years are eligible for the appointment of the Governor of a State.
solution:
The correct answer is __**35.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The key word in the question is "Governor of a State", which refers to the constitutional head of a state in India.

**Governor:**

 
• Under **Article 155 of the Indian Constitution,** the Governor of a State **shall be appointed by the President.**
 
• A person should have completed 35 years of age to be appointed as Governor.
 
• The Governor shall hold office at the pleasure of the President.
 
• The Governor constitutes the State Finance Commission every five years and the State election commissioner for elections to the Panchayats. 
 
• By the** 7th Constitutional Amendment Act of 1956,** the s**ame person can be appointed as a governor for two or more states.**
 
• **He is entitled to receive such emoluments, allowances, and privileges as may be determined by Parliament.**
 
• **When he is appointed for two or more states, the emoluments and allowances payable to him are shared by the respective states in such proportion as determined by the President. **
 
• A governor whose term has expired may be reappointed in the same state or any other state.
